hunt.justification: Industrial-scale distillation threatens U.S. technological leadership and model safety. Identifying the systematic extraction of proprietary capabilities is an obligation for frontier AI providers to protect their assets.

meta.name: Industrial-Scale AI Model Distillation and Extraction

related.reason: This hunt focuses on systematic distillation through fraudulent accounts, not the compromise of existing legitimate accounts via credential stuffing.

meta.analysis: A single detection rule cannot correlate the lifecycle of an account from fraudulent procurement through proxy evasion to massive token extraction. This hunt pivots across auth, network, DNS, and HTTP surfaces to prove the industrial scale required by the adversary.

stages.name: Fraudulent API Account Creation
observables: Creation of fraudulent accounts with similar registration details
Bulk procurement of premium subscriptions shared across developer teams
Immediate maximum usage from newly created accounts

stages.name: Geographic Evasion via Transfer Stations
observables: Use of gray market API proxies known as 'transfer stations'
Routing through third-party API aggregators to obfuscate metadata
Automated failover between multiple cloud providers and pathways

stages.name: Targeted Model Capability Extraction
observables: LLM Prompt Injection and Jailbreak attempts
Highly coordinated queries featuring identical prompt texts
Queries designed to trick model identity (e.g., claiming to be MiniMax products)

stages.name: Industrial-Scale Knowledge Distillation
observables: Extraction of billions of tokens across millions of requests
Enterprise-scale throughput patterns on individual accounts
Extraction of specialized domains (legal, coding, agentic functions)

scenario.summary: China-based AI companies are conducting industrial-scale knowledge distillation to extract proprietary capabilities from U.S. frontier AI models. The campaign uses fraudulent accounts, bulk subscriptions, and a gray market of 'transfer station' proxies to automate the extraction of billions of tokens while evading geographic and usage-based detection.

meta.rationale: The hunt scopes to hosts resolving known distillation domains. Focus investigation on accounts created within the lookback period and those demonstrating immediate high-throughput patterns.
meta.hypothesis: China-based adversaries are using fraudulent accounts and proxy transfer stations to conduct high-volume, automated extraction of proprietary AI model capabilities through systematic distillation.

scope_hosts.description: List of hosts found in the scoping step; paste back here to narrow subsequent queries.

min_shared_users.description: Minimum distinct users per source IP to flag a potential shared premium subscription.

min_request_count.description: Minimum request threshold to identify automated or industrial-scale behavior.

volume_threshold_bytes.description: Byte threshold (approx 1GB) per account/host to identify industrial-scale extraction.

ai_distillation_domains.description: Domains associated with China-based AI companies conducting distillation.

blind_spots.risk: Adversaries using encrypted tunnels can hide specific prompt injection TTPs, leaving only volume and metadata visible to the network stack.
blind_spots.question: What were the specific prompt contents within the HTTPS payload?
blind_spots.requires: TLS decryption at the proxy or application-level logging

blind_spots.risk: Rapid rotation of 'transfer station' IPs may allow adversaries to bypass static IP blocklists and evade detection between hunt cycles.
blind_spots.question: Are these source IPs part of a known transfer station proxy network?
blind_spots.requires: Real-time IP reputation and multi-platform intelligence sharing

hunt.name: Industrial-Scale AI Model Distillation and Extraction
hunt.description: China-based AI companies use industrial-scale knowledge distillation to bridge the gap between their models and US frontier models. This hunt identifies the infrastructure and behaviors of these campaigns by detecting the bulk procurement of shared premium subscriptions, the use of transfer station proxies to bypass geographic restrictions, and the exfiltration of billions of tokens via targeted API access. The hunt follows a phased flow, first confirming access and proxy anomalies before investigating execution and exfiltration signals.

config.scoping_notes: The hunt scopes to hosts resolving known distillation domains. Focus investigation on accounts created within the lookback period and those demonstrating immediate high-throughput patterns.
config.beyond_detection: A single detection rule cannot correlate the lifecycle of an account from fraudulent procurement through proxy evasion to massive token extraction. This hunt pivots across auth, network, DNS, and HTTP surfaces to prove the industrial scale required by the adversary.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) as lookup_count FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{ai_distillation_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname
config.description: Find hosts resolving domains associated with the infrastructure used for distillation campaigns.
config.expected_signal: A list of hosts communicating with distillation domains. Silence suggests no direct interaction with known Chinese AI provider infrastructure.

primitive_config.label: Identify interaction with distillation domains
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, query_hostname, COUNT(*) as lookup_count FROM hb_dns_activity WHERE instr(',' || '{{ai_distillation_domains}}' || ',', ',' || LOWER(query_hostname) || ',') > 0 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, query_hostname
primitive_config.expected: A list of hosts communicating with distillation domains. Silence suggests no direct interaction with known Chinese AI provider infrastructure.

config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) as user_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) as users FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 1 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip HAVING user_count >= {{min_shared_users}} ORDER BY user_count DESC
config.description: Detect multiple unique user identities authenticating from the same source IP, characteristic of bulk procurement.
config.expected_signal: Source IPs hosting many distinct users. This reflects the shared premium subscription tactic to reduce extraction costs.

primitive_config.label: Bulk premium subscription sharing
primitive_config.content: SELECT src_endpoint_ip, COUNT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) as user_count, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT actor_user_name) as users FROM hb_auth_signin WHERE status_id = 1 AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY src_endpoint_ip HAVING user_count >= {{min_shared_users}} ORDER BY user_count DESC
primitive_config.expected: Source IPs hosting many distinct users. This reflects the shared premium subscription tactic to reduce extraction costs.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, COUNT(*) as connection_count FROM hb_network_connection WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND dst_endpoint_port NOT IN (80, 443, 8080) AND direction = 'outbound' AND NOT (dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR (dst_endpoint_ip >= '172.16' AND dst_endpoint_ip < '172.32')) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port HAVING connection_count > 100 ORDER BY connection_count DESC
config.description: Identify high-frequency outbound connections to non-standard ports, excluding internal traffic to identify transfer stations.
config.expected_signal: Hosts generating massive connection volumes to non-standard remote ports. These are likely the transfer stations bypassing geo-restrictions.

primitive_config.label: Transfer station proxy activity
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port, COUNT(*) as connection_count FROM hb_network_connection WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND dst_endpoint_port NOT IN (80, 443, 8080) AND direction = 'outbound' AND NOT (dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '10.%' OR dst_endpoint_ip LIKE '192.168.%' OR (dst_endpoint_ip >= '172.16' AND dst_endpoint_ip < '172.32')) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, dst_endpoint_ip, dst_endpoint_port HAVING connection_count > 100 ORDER BY connection_count DESC
primitive_config.expected: Hosts generating massive connection volumes to non-standard remote ports. These are likely the transfer stations bypassing geo-restrictions.

config.objective: Evaluate whether the shared accounts and transfer station proxies identify automated distillation activity.
config.description: Determine if the account and network patterns indicate the beginning of a distillation campaign.
config.expected_signal: A per-host and per-IP verdict on whether access appears to be automated distillation infrastructure.
config.success_criteria: Verdicts citing specific IPs and accounts characteristic of the adversary lifecycle.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_hostname, url_path, COUNT(*) as hit_count FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/v1/chat/completions%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/v1/embeddings%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/v1/completions%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/v1/models%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, url_hostname, url_path HAVING hit_count > {{min_request_count}}
config.description: Detect systematic access to specific API paths like completions or embeddings, indicating automated distillation.
config.expected_signal: High-frequency request patterns targeting model reasoning endpoints. Silence may mean traffic is encrypted or the analyst should verify TLS inspection.

primitive_config.label: High-frequency API endpoint access
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, url_hostname, url_path, COUNT(*) as hit_count FROM hb_http_activity WHERE (LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/v1/chat/completions%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/v1/embeddings%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/v1/completions%' OR LOWER(url_path) LIKE '%/v1/models%') AND ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, url_hostname, url_path HAVING hit_count > {{min_request_count}}
primitive_config.expected: High-frequency request patterns targeting model reasoning endpoints. Silence may mean traffic is encrypted or the analyst should verify TLS inspection.

config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, url_hostname, SUM(response_bytes) as total_bytes, COUNT(*) as request_count FROM hb_http_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, actor_user_name, url_hostname HAVING total_bytes > {{volume_threshold_bytes}} AND request_count >= {{min_request_count}} ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
config.description: Identify massive byte transfers and request volumes per host or user, confirming the industrial scale of extraction.
config.expected_signal: Users or hosts exceeding both byte and request thresholds. This confirms the 'millions of requests' behavior reported in the advisory.

primitive_config.label: Industrial-scale throughput detection
primitive_config.content: SELECT device_hostname, actor_user_name, url_hostname, SUM(response_bytes) as total_bytes, COUNT(*) as request_count FROM hb_http_activity WHERE ('{{scope_hosts}}' = '' OR instr(',' || '{{scope_hosts}}' || ',', ',' || device_hostname || ',') > 0) AND time >= datetime('now', '-{{lookback_days}} days') GROUP BY device_hostname, actor_user_name, url_hostname HAVING total_bytes > {{volume_threshold_bytes}} AND request_count >= {{min_request_count}} ORDER BY total_bytes DESC
primitive_config.expected: Users or hosts exceeding both byte and request thresholds. This confirms the 'millions of requests' behavior reported in the advisory.
